positions_en: Professor, Department of Civil Engineering, National Taiwan University
Director, The Research Center for Water Resources and Disaster Management, NTUCE
bio_en: Dr. Shang-Shu Shih joined the Department of Civil Engineering at National Taiwan University as an Assistant Professor (2017-2018), became Associate Professor (2018-2022), and has been a Full Professor since 2022. His work integrates knowledge, principles and methods from engineering and ecology to develop interdisciplinary approaches and models dedicated to solving integrated management problems regarding the ecological degradation and rehabilitation of rivers and wetlands. He established and organizes The Research Center for Water Resources and Disaster Management and the Lab of Eco-hydrology and Eco-DRR in the department. He is also experienced in practical hydraulic engineering and river environmental planning, in both physical and mathematical model simulation and field survey. Several research projects are conducted under his supervision, sponsored by diverse units including the National Science and Technology Council, the Water Resources Agency, and the Construction and Planning Agency. He serves as General Secretary of the Asia Chapter of the Society of Wetland Scientists (SWS), a committee member of the Hazard Mitigation Panel of the Chinese Institute of Civil and Hydraulic Engineering, an editorial board member of the Journal of Taiwan Agricultural Engineering, and a reviewer for several academic journals.
bio_zh: 施上粟教授於 2017 年進入國立臺灣大學土木工程學系任教，歷任助理教授（2017-2018）、副教授（2018-2022），2022 年起擔任教授。研究上整合工程與生態學的知識、原理與方法，發展跨領域途徑與模式，致力於解決河川與濕地生態劣化及復育的整合性管理問題。他建立並主持土木系水資源與災害管理研究中心及生態水文與生態減災研究室。除學術研究外，亦具備豐富的水利工程實務與河川環境規劃經驗，涵蓋物理模型與數值模式模擬以及現地調查。所主持之研究計畫由國家科學及技術委員會、經濟部水利署、內政部國土管理署等單位補助。同時擔任國際濕地科學家學會（SWS）亞洲分會秘書長、中國土木水利工程學會防災委員會委員、台灣農業工程學報編輯委員，並為多份國際期刊審稿人。
